fixture_a.topology: 3 tracks: 2 video tracks and 1 audio track; 2 sequential video clips; 1 track-owned CrossDissolve; 1 nonlinear-eased title overlay; 1 audio bed with nonlinear volume automation.

benchmark_methodology.timing: Warmups followed by repeated samples; median and P95 computed where applicable; only successful, correlated responses count.
benchmark_methodology.jsonl: Real release tinixcut session subprocess over OS stdin/stdout; Fixture B; 5 warmups and 50 samples; apply uses saveAfter:false and is in-memory, not durable-save latency.
benchmark_methodology.mcp: Real release tinixcut mcp subprocess over OS stdin/stdout; valid initialization/framing and correlated JSON-RPC responses; Fixture B; 5 warmups and 30 samples; durable apply performs a unique real mutation, revision increment, disk persistence, and independent reload.
benchmark_methodology.export: Bundled FFmpeg 9.0.2, libx264 preset fast, CRF 23, 1 warmup plus 5 measured exports per resolution; outputs probed for H.264/AAC and accepted duration.
benchmark_methodology.qualification_classification: Hard qualification ceilings and accepted Fixture-B reference-host median budgets are reported separately.

jsonl_fixture_b_os_stdio.apply_semantics: In-memory saveAfter:false; not durable persistence latency.

fixture_a_cpu_libx264.qualification_note: Export probing does not establish live dropped-frame performance, physical A/V sync, or cross-encoder bitstream identity.
